text:
ana: quick design check on the header/action stack in the new dashboard modal. on small widths the primary CTA overlaps the title when there are two secondary icons. noticed on safari mobile.

	 tom: saw that too. current layout uses inline-flex with gap: 8px which collapses with long titles.

	 devon: can we keep visual spacing but move hit targets apart? wcag recommends 44px touch targets. maybe increase interactive area without changing icon visual size.

	 ana: exact ask: keep icon visuals at 16px, make hit area 44px, and add a token for header-action-gap so teams can opt-in.

	 kiri: also, on narrow breakpoints secondary actions should collapse into a kebab menu. less friction for scanning. i can mock the breakpoint at 420px. :thinking_face: 

	 tom: CSS sketch:

```
.header .action { width:44px; height:44px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:0; border-radius:6px; }
.header .action .icon { width:16px; height:16px; }
.header { gap: var(--header-action-gap, 12px); }
```

	 devon: add aria-labels for each action so screen readers don't read the kebab items as "button unknown". also ensure focus-visible uses existing focus token (--focus-ring).

	 ana: toast collision note: when modal is pinned right, toasts currently appear top-right and overlap action hit areas. suggested: add `--modal-safe-margin: 8px` and nudge toasts down by that amount when a modal is present.

	 kiri: i'll prototype kebab fallback + screenshot this afternoon.

	 tom: i'll open a small PR for the CSS and token addition. include unit test for focus-visible.

	 design-bot: Created task COMPONENTS-412 "header: increase action hit area, header-action-gap token, kebab fallback, modal safe margin for toasts" Milestone: 2.16.0.

	 ana: thanks — if no objections we'll merge the token and CSS tweak after review. resolving thread.
